title: Security group egress open to the world
description: Egress rules allowing 0.0.0.0/0 permit unrestricted outbound traffic, aiding data exfiltration. Restrict destinations to required ranges. Unrestricted egress is the AWS default and by itself is not a misconfiguration, so this rule fires only on evidence the group carries live traffic: the group is attached to a workload resource in the same module, or the finding comes from a standalone egress-rule resource that explicitly targets the group. A standalone security group with no attachments carries no traffic and is not flagged.

title: EC2 instance without IMDSv2 enforcement
description: Without metadata_options.http_tokens = "required", the instance metadata service accepts IMDSv1 requests, which SSRF vulnerabilities can abuse to steal credentials.

title: EC2 instance without detailed monitoring
description: With monitoring absent or false (the provider default), the instance ships only basic 5-minute CloudWatch metrics, delaying detection of performance and availability issues.

title: EC2 instance without termination protection
description: disable_api_termination is absent or false, so the instance can be terminated by an accidental or malicious API call. Enable it for instances that must not be deleted casually.

title: EC2 instance without ebs_optimized declared
description: ebs_optimized is absent, so the provider default (false) applies: the instance gets no dedicated EBS bandwidth. Declare ebs_optimized = true on EBS-backed workloads.

title: EC2 instance without an IAM instance profile
description: iam_instance_profile is absent, so the instance has no IAM role: any AWS access must come from credentials baked into the image or user_data. Attach an instance profile with least-privilege permissions instead.

title: EC2 root volume without encryption
description: root_block_device with encrypted absent or false leaves the instance's root volume unencrypted at rest, exposing the OS disk and any data written to it. Set encrypted = true.

title: EC2 instance without Nitro Enclaves enabled
description: enclave_options is absent, so Nitro Enclaves are unavailable on this instance. Workloads that process sensitive data should enable enclave_options { enabled = true } to isolate it.
